result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.closeness_vitality()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get closeness vitality centrality for each node. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L16824-L16903){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.closeness_vitality(attr_name=None, return_dict=False) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Closeness vitality measures a node's importance by computing the change in total graph distances when the node is removed: `vitality(v) = sum_distances(G) - sum_distances(G - v)` Higher values indicate more important/central nodes whose removal would significantly increase average path lengths. Uses parallel BFS with Rayon for efficient computation. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [attr_name]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Name for the node attribute to store results. If not provided, auto-generates name from method name (`closeness_vitality`). [return_dict]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, returns dictionary of results. If `False`, stores results as node attributes and returns self for method chaining. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Union[dict[int, float], Graph]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If `return_dict=` is `True`: dictionary mapping node IDs to vitality scores. If `return_dict=` is `False`: returns self for method chaining. Higher scores indicate more structurally important nodes. ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} Computationally expensive for large graphs (O(V²E / num_cores) complexity). Consider alternative centrality measures (degree, PageRank) for graphs with >1000 nodes unless high accuracy is required. ## Examples {.doc-examples} Calculate closeness vitality in a star graph: ::: {#d009ab7d .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="hub") .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("hub", "A") .add_edge("hub", "B") .add_edge("hub", "C") ) vitality = graph.closeness_vitality(return_dict=True) hub_id = graph.get_id_from_label("hub") a_id = graph.get_id_from_label("A") # Hub has highest vitality (removal disconnects graph) assert vitality[hub_id] > vitality[a_id] # Convert to labels if needed label_vitality = {graph.get_label_from_id(nid): score for nid, score in vitality.items()} ``` :::
